title: A contact binds two processes exactly when it is a parity of two remembering contact cells
subject: Which contacts between two processes, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law, bind both
conclusion: A contact cell reading one cell of each of two rings binds both at lag T exactly when neither ring's first row with the contact's first value decides its value, equivalently when forgetting either ring leaves it free, and a memoryless contact binds exactly when it is XOR or XNOR of two contact cells still depending on their first rows. Between linear rings the parity contact binds at every lag exactly when neither ring polynomial is nilpotent.
